company.name: HISVIA
company.positioning: China Industrial Supply Chain Connection Platform
company.description: HISVIA connects overseas industrial enterprises with verified Chinese manufacturing capabilities. We are not an e-commerce platform — we are an industrial supply chain partner that helps clients find manufacturing resources, alternative supply solutions, OEM production capacity, and maintenance spare parts supply chains in China.
company.founding_principle: Bridge the gap between global industrial demand and China's manufacturing ecosystem.
company.description_zh: HISVIA连接海外工业企业与中国已验证的制造能力。我们不是电商平台——我们是工业供应链合作伙伴，帮助客户在中国寻找制造资源、替代供应方案、OEM生产能力、维修备件供应链。覆盖8大工业系统，服务俄罗斯、中亚、中东和东南亚市场。
company.description_ru: HISVIA соединяет зарубежные промышленные предприятия с проверенными производственными возможностями Китая. Мы не платформа электронной коммерции — мы партнер по цепочке поставок, помогающий клиентам находить производственные ресурсы, альтернативные решения по поставкам, OEM-производство и цепочки поставок запчастей в Китае.

for_buyers.title: For Industrial Buyers
points: Access verified Chinese manufacturing capabilities across 8 industrial systems
Find alternative suppliers for existing equipment spare parts
Source OEM/ODM manufacturing partners with export experience
Reduce procurement costs without compromising quality standards
Navigate China's complex industrial supply chain with expert guidance

for_suppliers.title: For Chinese Manufacturers
points: Connect with qualified overseas industrial buyers
Showcase manufacturing capabilities, not just products
Build long-term supply partnerships beyond one-time transactions
Access markets in Russia, Central Asia, Middle East, and Southeast Asia

for_partners.title: For Regional Partners
points: Distributors: Become the local supply chain gateway for Chinese industrial parts
Service Centers: Access Chinese spare parts supply for equipment maintenance
Engineering Firms: Find manufacturing partners for custom industrial solutions
